basis: FAM-03a-OS-M001, from the FAM-01-OS-M001 matrix. A source contract only: what the pinned public sources say about each hardware target and how Rose reaches it. It is not evidence that anything was downloaded, generated, compiled, signed, booted or installed, and it does not admit a device to delivery (os/release-pipeline and its workflow decide that; only frankel is admitted there). Checked by os/tests/test_device_contract.py against the pinned fixtures in os/tests/fixtures/adevtool-17df3b79.

source.note: The pinned manifest equals GrapheneOS platform_manifest 2026100600 default.xml. It has no per-device Pixel tree: adevtool generates vendor/google_devices/<device> from the stock factory image and supplies the device product makefiles.

roseInclusion.basis: Every Rose product edit is made to shared build/make products that each device reaches through the inheritance above; no Rose patch or overlay names a Pixel device. Source path only: no compiled APK, APEX or image of blazer or rango exists.

products.target/product/generic_system.mk: agent tray property (agent-tray-build-make.patch) and VirtualDeviceManager (background-control-build-make.patch); inherited directly by common/product-common.mk
products.target/product/handheld_system_ext.mk: PixelBackgroundControl controller and the computer-control extension (background-control-build-make.patch); inherited directly
products.target/product/media_system.mk: the existing Updater (updater-product-build-make.patch); reached generic_system -> handheld_system -> media_system
products.target/product/handheld_product.mk: Rose Agent, Calculator and the other preinstalls (apply-os-changes.py PRODUCT_MAKEFILE); reached aosp_product -> handheld_product

projects.frameworks/base: SystemUI tray, WM Shell and background-control framework patches
projects.build/release: release config cur (background-control-build-release.patch); the lunch release is cur on every device
projects.packages/apps/Updater: Rose channels (updater-rose-channels.patch); the Updater requests DEVICE-channel from Build.DEVICE
projects.packages/apps/Launcher3: Rose Agent work row in the fallback overview (rose-switcher-launcher3.patch); device-independent quickstep layout
